business_problem: Preply wanted to personalize language learning more deeply and reduce repetitive tutor work without replacing the human relationship that makes one-to-one teaching effective.
solution_summary: Preply built Lesson Insights on top of OpenAI so each live lesson could become a personalized learning loop instead of a standalone conversation. With learner consent, lessons in the Preply Classroom are recorded and transcribed, then an OpenAI-powered workflow generates structured feedback on grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, lesson topics, and next steps just before the session ends so tutor and learner can review it together. Those outputs feed directly into Preply's self-learning exercise engine, creating personalized homework and practice that compounds lesson to lesson. Internally, Preply also deployed ChatGPT Enterprise across more than 600 employees and embedded OpenAI APIs, custom GPTs such as Brand Voice GPT, and Codex into content and engineering workflows. By pairing AI with human tutors rather than replacing them, Preply created a system where the platform handles summary, structure, and personalization while tutors focus on motivation, context, and teaching judgment.

data_flow: Lesson recordings and transcripts from the Preply Classroom are processed through the OpenAI API into summaries, corrections, recommendations, and next steps. Those insights flow into the chat thread and self-learning engine, while internal teams use ChatGPT Enterprise, Brand Voice GPT, and Codex for operational and product workflows.
business_outcome: Preply increased internal AI adoption, helped tutors and learners keep engaging with personalized lesson follow-ups over time, and reduced the administrative burden of teaching while improving the continuity and perceived value of each learning journey.
